## EverCommerce Appoints Alex Goor as Chief Executive Officer
...
August 5, 2026
...
DENVER, Aug. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- EverCommerce Inc. (NASDAQ: EVCM), a company dedicated to simplifying small service businesses, today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Alex Goor as Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board of Directors, effective August 6, 2026. Goor succeeds EverCommerce founder and CEO Eric Remer, who has made the decision to step down from the CEO role and will continue serving as a member of the Company’s Board of Directors.

Today, I'm honored to begin serving as Chief Executive Officer of EverCommerce. Throughout my career, I've been fortunate to work with organizations at important moments of transformation. What drew me to EverCommerce was the opportunity to join a company with an important mission, exceptional people, and the opportunity to help hundreds of thousands of service businesses succeed every day. EverCommerce has built a strong foundation across Home, Health, and Wellness, with talented teams, deep industry expertise, and a clear commitment to helping customers simplify their work and grow their businesses. Over the coming weeks, my priority is simple: listen, learn, and build relationships across the organization. I'll be spending time with our employees and stakeholders to better understand what we're doing well, where we can improve, and how we can continue creating long-term value together. I also want to thank Eric Remer for the company he has built and for the leadership that has brought EverCommerce to this point. I look forward to building on the strong foundation he and the team have created. I'm excited for what comes next!
...
As a member of the EVCM board, I am thrilled to be part of the crew to welcome Alex as our new CEO! Onwards and upwards.

Building EverCommerce has been the privilege of my professional life. None of what we've accomplished would have been possible without the incredible employees, customers, partners, and leaders who believed in our mission and helped shape this company along the way. One of the most important responsibilities of any founder is ensuring the company is positioned to succeed well beyond them, and I believe this is the right moment for EverCommerce's next chapter. Thank you to everyone who has been part of this journey, and thank you to our team for welcoming and supporting EverCommerce’s new CEO Alex Goor. The future of EverCommerce is bright and I'm excited to see Alex and the leadership team build on this foundation and lead the company into its next phase of growth, innovation and impact.

EverCommerce (NASDAQ:EVCM) reported second-quarter revenue that grew 2.7% year over year to $152 million, while adjusted EBITDA of $44.5 million exceeded the company's guidance range. The company maintained its full-year outlook but said results are now expected to trend toward the lower end of its revenue and adjusted EBITDA ranges, reflecting slower-than-expected new customer acquisition in certain EverPro offerings. 

The earnings call also marked a leadership transition. Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Eric Remer said he would step down as CEO effective Aug. 6 after nearly two decades leading the company, while remaining on EverCommerce's board. Alex Goor will become CEO and join the board.

Matt Feierstein is the President of EverCommerce, overseeing the holistic business operations and accountable to the revenue and profitability of its subsidiaries. He is passionate about leading teams, and building scale & efficiency for companies that helps them grow to their fullest potential.

# EverCommerce Appoints Alex Goor as New Chief Executive
...
- EverCommerce named Alex Goor as CEO and director effective August 6, 2026, replacing founder Eric Remer and granting him substantial cash and equity incentives tied to long-term performance.
- For the quarter ended June 30, 2026, EverCommerce posted modest revenue and income growth, flat adjusted EBITDA, repurchased 1.4 million shares, and guided full-year results toward the low end of its forecast.

On August 5, 2026, EverCommerce’s board appointed veteran technology and financial services executive Alex Goor as chief executive officer and Class I director, effective August 6, 2026, succeeding founder Eric Remer, who stepped down as CEO and chairman but remains on the board. The company detailed Goor’s compensation package, including salary, bonus eligibility, severance protections and sizable time-based and performance-based equity grants tied to multi-year service and stock-price hurdles, underscoring a governance shift toward incentivizing long-term growth and value creation.
